Chapter 982: Chapter 2: Exploring the Origin World (Please Subscribe)

Human Universe, Martial Arts Evolution Tower.

“Thirty thousand chaos stones…” Lin Yuan examined his own possessions.

Currently, he only has a few thousand chaos stones, all of which were left to him by the peak dominator ‘Cang Weiyang’.

To buy that golden box related to the Profound Xuanhuang lineage, Lin Yuan plans to gather as many chaos stones as possible, up to thirty thousand.

“It looks like I need to sell some weapons and arms,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

At the moment, he has many surplus weapons and arms, but most are of the Path Splitting Realm level, with only a few dominator-level weapons and treasures from ‘Cang Weiyang’.

“First, I’ll send these weapons and treasures to the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming, then sell them and see if it’s enough,” Lin Yuan picked some weapons and treasures from his treasury that he doesn’t need.

If the chaos stones obtained from selling these weapons and treasures are still not enough, Lin Yuan plans to sell a few dominator realm rare trees.

As for that Chaos Realm secret treasure? It’s better not to sell if possible, since Lin Yuan can use it once he steps into the dominator realm.

“Still lacking chaos stones…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In fact, with Lin Yuan’s current understanding and perception of Chaos Qi, he could completely refine chaos stones directly from the mixed Chaos Qi like a Chaos Venerable.

But being able to do it is one thing, and efficiency is another.

Without the powerful spiritual will of a Chaos Venerable and the support of an internal universe, the chaos stones Lin Yuan can refine in a year would probably not exceed ten.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan raised his hand and tore open a spatial rift, piercing through all spatial layers, connecting the universe and the Chaos Void.

He then threw the chosen treasures through the rift and, with a thought, a manifestation formed outside the spatial rift within the Chaos Void, receiving the numerous treasures.

Now even as a manifestation, Lin Yuan has the fighting abilities of a peak of Path Splitting Realm, fully enough to make his way in the Chaos Void.

Whirl.

Lin Yuan waved his hand, and the spatial rift some tens of meters long quickly healed.

Having torn through all the spatial layers of the universe, Lin Yuan could easily form an Eternal Spatial Rift if he wished.

“Each strand of World-Breaking Origin Force requires ninety days to accumulate, is that already the limit, unable to be increased further?” Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

Since stepping into the twelfth layer, Lin Yuan had been trying to increase the speed of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force, to tear open larger Eternal Spatial Rifts.

But the efficiency of the Myriad Realms Gate in accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force still remains at one strand every ninety days and has not increased further.

“Could there be unknown conditions for absorbing World-Breaking Origin Force I am not aware of?” Lin Yuan pondered.

…

Martial Arts Evolution Tower.

Lin Yuan actively connected with the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Honored human supreme, the Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to serve you,” the solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom resounded.

The three goddesses of human civilization, core parts originating from an incident involving countless treasures falling from beyond the universe, are one of the biggest opportunities human civilization has obtained, possessing mental and computational powers on par with dominator realm beings.

That is why they can support the almost endless major and minor decisions of human civilization.

“Upload the twelfth layer Path Splitting Chapter,” Lin Yuan spoke.

The twelfth-layer Path Splitting Chapter of Martial Tao has been essentially completed and perfected by him for upload.

In fact, whether to upload the twelfth-layer Path Splitting Chapter of Martial Tao or not is not very significant, as aside from Lin Yuan falling, no other cultivator of Martial Tao could step into the twelfth layer.

“If there’s time, I can start branching out from Martial Tao,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

A pathway of evolution is akin to a major road; if this major road is broad enough, it can branch out into many paths.

These branches are also considered major roads, based on Martial Tao and leading in different directions, also capable of birthing twelfth-layer entities.

Of course, this is contingent on the main road having substantial depth, akin to branches of a river. If it’s merely a stream, its branches won’t go far, but if it’s a large river, even its branches will be broader than a stream.

“Based on Martial Tao, the derived branch pathways can also bring benefits to myself,” Lin Yuan realized during his ultimate leap, recognizing the advantages of widely spreading his path.

That could maintain himself from never falling, which is considerably more challenging than having unlimited lifespan.

…

With the upload of the twelfth-layer Path Splitting Chapter, the Martial Arts Evolution pathway smoothly became the first evolutionary pathway of human civilization.

This event did not cause any surprises, even in the eyes of countless human cultivators and the nine supreme beings, it was extremely normal and to be expected.

Martial Arts Evolution pathway was previously ranked fifth in humanity just based on the eleventh-layer chapter. Now with the twelfth-layer Path Splitting Chapter uploaded, it would be strange if it weren’t first.

…

Martial Arts Evolution Tower.

“Tower Master, this is the list of all who have made contributions to human civilization and have passed away since its birth,”

Zhang Tianzhi stood respectfully below, as the first eighth-layer of Martial Arts Evolution pathway, Zhang Tianzhi joined the Martial Arts Evolution Tower immediately.

Although limited by strength, his position isn’t high, but he has successfully caught Lin Yuan’s attention.

Lin Yuan glanced at the list, which densely recorded hundreds of millions of human names.

Although the Starry Sea Era of human civilization is only over two million years, the actual history far exceeds this number. In such a long duration, how many humans have been born? Even if only a small percentage made contributions to human civilization, the base number is too large.

“Tower Master, do you plan to resurrect them?”

Zhang Tianzhi cautiously asked.

“Those who have contributed to human civilization naturally can be resurrected,” Lin Yuan said.

In the past, the resurrection of deceased evolvers by human civilization had numerous prerequisites: potential, strength, and contribution were the foremost.

All three were indispensable, considering the nine supremes of human civilization.

The supremes revitalizing deceased lives would suffer cosmic rebuke: one or two might be fine, even hundreds or thousands manageable, but too many would overwhelm even the supremes, causing them injuries.

But now, Lin Yuan’s life force was unprecedentedly strong, and even if he revived lives at the eleventh tier, he could easily neutralize and disregard the backlash, which is why he planned to lower the resurrection threshold and extend the retrospective time range.

This was also considered a benefit for the deceased ancestors of human civilization.

….

Several days later.

All human civilization evolvers of ninth tier or above gathered outside the Martial Arts Evolution Tower.

The supremes resurrecting past lives need to reverse the flow, concerning the rules of space-time manifestation, watching this would give evolvers insights.

In the past, when the supremes from various Evolution Towers resurrected, crowds of evolvers also gathered to watch, and Lin Yuan had once witnessed Xia Qin, the Supreme, performing resurrection.

“The Galaxy Supreme is resurrecting the past deceased lives of my human civilization?”

“It’s said that this time the Galaxy Supreme’s resurrection scope is unprecedentedly broad, anyone who has made even a slight contribution to human civilization, regardless of their potential or strength, is on the resurrection list.”

“My god, resurrecting so many people, what kind of backlash would he endure?”

…

Many cultivators of human civilization discussed animatedly, now that human civilization occupied the entire universe, thus there was no issue of resource scarcity.

Xuanyuan Supreme and Xia Qin Supreme also rushed over; they initially planned to help Lin Yuan share some of the pressure but were rejected.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan had previously resurrected past relatives and friends in the Immortal Realm, but the time river of the Immortal Realm is distinctly different from the universe’s time river.

The time river of the Main Universe is strictly a tributary of the Chaos Void time river.

Humming sounds.

Lin Yuan began to reverse the flow, with a resurrection list in hand, clearly knowing the essence and aura of every human evolver to be resurrected, Lin Yuan continually fished out people from the vast time river.

“Wake up, everyone.”

With a gentle effort from Lin Yuan, over ten billion evolvers were forcibly pulled out, returning to the current time period.

In each moment, ten billion evolvers were resurrected, in a few breaths, the total revived exceeded one trillion.

“The Galaxy Supreme… How come the cosmic rebuke, when it reaches the Galaxy Master, couldn’t even ripple?” Many elevens were shocked.

The resurrection of ten billion lives almost made the universe’s time river locally boil, the towering backlash all pressed towards the Galaxy Supreme, but it didn’t even lift the hem of Lin Yuan’s robe.

“The life essence is too strong, I feel if it wasn’t for our life essence not being in the time river, the Galaxy Supreme could even resurrect us too,” Xuanyuan Supreme and other eight supremes were similarly astonished; they’ve resurrected many times and knew well what cosmic rebuke is like, the resurrection of ten billion, even for supremes would result directly in severe injuries, especially since each of Lin Yuan’s resurrections were also at the billion level.

In a short time, a few breaths passed, and the resurrected lives exceeded one trillion.

…

“I… I’ve been resurrected?”

“Has my human civilization reached its ultimate birth?”

Countless evolvers from before the Starry Sea Era widened their eyes; in their era, human civilization did not yet have twelfth-tier existence, and they never imagined they could have a chance to be resurrected.

…

“I… I was also resurrected?”

A cold man looked astonished; his name was ‘Ou Yin’, who perished at the hands of the Black Abyss and Qingyu, originally, according to his potential, talent, and strength, he had no qualifications for resurrection.

“The Galaxy Supreme…”

Ou Yin looked up, only to see a towering figure slowly lowering his head to glance over here, his face betokening a benevolent smile.

“The legacy I left in the Battlefields of Different Races, was it obtained by the Galaxy Master?”

Ou Yin immediately understood the cause and effect, while a sense of inexplicable emotion surged in his heart.

…

“Almost everyone has been resurrected.”

Lin Yuan glanced over the densely packed lives that had just been resurrected, then looked at the surrounding numerous eleventh-tier evolvers, entrusted them with the responsibility of arranging these resurrected lives, and immediately disappeared.

…

Martial Arts Evolution Tower.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Everything is almost done,” Lin Yuan took a deep breath, “Now I can properly explore that original world.”

With this thought, Lin Yuan divided his attention, sank into the depths of his mind, and looked towards the towering and grand Myriad Realms Gate.
